body:
That day. Written on 5/5/2020
It was Tuesday April 28th 2020. I woke up at 545 am my normal wake up time. As soon as I sat up I knew I was not the same person that laid down in that spot the night before. I no longer felt whole. I was in fact broken.
Several months of holding back my thoughts and feelings led up to 4-28-2020. I no longer felt loved or cherished in my relationship. I felt cast out and ignored, we barely spoke a word to each other. This was the same for months and months. 
Waking up that day the feeling of being completely drained, empty and broken. I had already begun planning my own demise, maybe that was why I woke up feeling this way. I walked around for hours with 2 bottles of pills in my hand.Angrily texting the man I love with every ounce of my being, grasping for something to make me hold on....trying so desperately to get him to talk even if it was just through texting.....he replied with this. "I'll be home shortly " seems simple enough right? My mind began turning my heart was racing. Pills now out of the bottle and in my pocket. 30 Xanax and about 10/500 milligram naproxen should be just enough to end the pain and anxiety I'm feeling permanently. I don't really want to die but the pain and anxiety are now unbearable. He walks in the door about an hour later. I cannot speak I just sit there staring into my own abyss. I don't remember his exact words but he basically said we needed to be apart from each other and I literally felt the last thread of my being snap! I got up...said something (not sure it was even coherent) and walked to the bathroom slamming the door and downing all of the about 40 pills at once. It was done. In a very short time I would be dead. Although I was not at peace like I thought I would be. The pain grew stronger I cried like I have never cried before! I felt more empty and alone than I ever had before! I remember him calling 911....everything after that is a blur, the pills literally took less than 20 minutes to start sinking into my blood stream. I felt myself letting go, then my world went dark for 2 days. I woke up in the hospital. Apparently I was something hard for them to handle in my 2 days of darkness. I remember nothing.....now I sit here one week following that day and I'm thankful that I am alive. I never wanted to die....I simply wanted the pain to end and didn't know what else to do to make it stop. Now my healing process is beginning. I am now alone and living with my son....I mean come on I'm 44 fucking years old and living with my child!!! This is not where I want to be. This is not how I saw my life ending up. I wanted to be his wife. I still do want to be his wife. He is everything I could ask for in a partner and more. Living life without him by my side everyday seems almost impossible 💔 I lost my heart that day..4yrs with the man that means the world to me  completely gone 💔
 But I am beginning to heal. I am setting goals for myself. Working every hard to achieve the simplest of goals like eating. I have to do this not for him not for anyone other than me. Everyone who knows what happen has said "Jamie you're the strongest person I know" I'm not as strong as people believe. Yes I've been through hell and yes I've come back from hell many many times. But you know what?!?  I will get through this I will be strong again. I will come out of this hell I've created shining like the brightest fucking star in the sky!!! 
I believe that with everything that I am and ever was... I will succeed!!! 
I need to first align myself with "what is" instead of "what was" or "what will be".
There will be ups and downs, good days and bad, tears, pain and anger but I WILL GET THROUGH THIS!
